violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed employee coming in from the outside and didn't wash hands.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Observed reach in freezer that needs to be cleaned more frequently.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in upright freezer.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Observed trash on floor of walk in freezer.
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
